import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
from io import StringIO

# Create the dataset
data = """Person ID,Gender,Age,Occupation,Sleep Duration,Quality of Sleep,Physical Activity Level,Stress Level,BMI Category,Blood Pressure,Heart Rate,Daily Steps,Sleep Disorder
1,Male,27,Software Engineer,6.1,6,42,6,Overweight,126/83,77,4200,
2,Male,28,Doctor,6.2,6,60,8,Normal,125/80,75,10000,
3,Male,28,Doctor,6.2,6,60,8,Normal,125/80,75,10000,
4,Male,28,Sales Representative,5.9,4,30,8,Obese,140/90,85,3000,Sleep Apnea
5,Male,28,Sales Representative,5.9,4,30,8,Obese,140/90,85,3000,Sleep Apnea"""

df = pd.read_csv(StringIO(data))

# Clean Sleep Disorder column
df['Sleep Disorder'] = df['Sleep Disorder'].fillna('None')

# Create figure with multiple subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 3, figsize=(15, 10))
fig.suptitle('Sleep Health and Lifestyle Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold')

# 1. Sleep Duration vs Quality of Sleep by BMI Category
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
colors = {'Normal': '#2ecc71', 'Overweight': '#f39c12', 'Obese': '#e74c3c'}
for bmi in df['BMI Category'].unique():
    subset = df[df['BMI Category'] == bmi]
    ax1.scatter(subset['Sleep Duration'], subset['Quality of Sleep'], 
                c=colors.get(bmi, '#3498db'), label=bmi, s=100, alpha=0.7, edgecolors='black')
ax1.set_xlabel('Sleep Duration (hours)')
ax1.set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep')
ax1.set_title('Sleep Duration vs Quality by BMI')
ax1.legend()
ax1.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# 2. Physical Activity Level by Occupation
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
occupation_activity = df.groupby('Occupation')['Physical Activity Level'].mean().sort_values()
bars = ax2.barh(occupation_activity.index, occupation_activity.values, color=['#3498db', '#9b59b6', '#1abc9c'])
ax2.set_xlabel('Physical Activity Level')
ax2.set_title('Physical Activity by Occupation')
ax2.bar_label(bars, fmt='%.0f')

# 3. Stress Level vs Heart Rate
ax3 = axes[0, 2]
scatter = ax3.scatter(df['Stress Level'], df['Heart Rate'], 
                       c=df['Daily Steps'], cmap='viridis', s=150, alpha=0.7, edgecolors='black')
ax3.set_xlabel('Stress Level')
ax3.set_ylabel('Heart Rate (bpm)')
ax3.set_title('Stress Level vs Heart Rate\n(colored by Daily Steps)')
plt.colorbar(scatter, ax=ax3, label='Daily Steps')

# 4. BMI Category Distribution
ax4 = axes[1, 0]
bmi_counts = df['BMI Category'].value_counts()
wedges, texts, autotexts = ax4.pie(bmi_counts.values, labels=bmi_counts.index, autopct='%1.0f%%',
                                    colors=['#2ecc71', '#f39c12', '#e74c3c'], explode=[0.05]*len(bmi_counts))
ax4.set_title('BMI Category Distribution')

# 5. Sleep Disorder by Occupation
ax5 = axes[1, 1]
disorder_occ = pd.crosstab(df['Occupation'], df['Sleep Disorder'])
disorder_occ.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax5, color=['#3498db', '#e74c3c'], edgecolor='black')
ax5.set_xlabel('Occupation')
ax5.set_ylabel('Count')
ax5.set_title('Sleep Disorder by Occupation')
ax5.legend(title='Sleep Disorder')
ax5.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# 6. Daily Steps vs Sleep Quality
ax6 = axes[1, 2]
disorder_colors = {'None': '#2ecc71', 'Sleep Apnea': '#e74c3c'}
for disorder in df['Sleep Disorder'].unique():
    subset = df[df['Sleep Disorder'] == disorder]
    ax6.scatter(subset['Daily Steps'], subset['Quality of Sleep'],
                c=disorder_colors.get(disorder, '#3498db'), label=disorder, s=150, alpha=0.7, edgecolors='black')
ax6.set_xlabel('Daily Steps')
ax6.set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep')
ax6.set_title('Daily Steps vs Sleep Quality\nby Sleep Disorder')
ax6.legend()
ax6.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight', facecolor='white')
plt.close()
